summary: Agent confirmed v2 failure by running 3 models and observing std=0.029 with scores clustering at 0.45-0.50. Diagnosed root cause as rules being re-provided fresh in every prompt, eliminating any interference effect. First redesign attempt presented multiple competing systems in context but produced near-zero scores due to a bug in _gather_test_items where variant systems generated test items with wrong expected outputs for the base system. Second fix used only native test items (5 per system) across 3 difficulty tiers. This produced good spread (Sonnet=1.0, Nova=0.783) but Ministral errored on hard tier due to context length. Final fix reduced example count in hard tier, yielding Ministral=0.441. Updated both task_interference.py and the notebook to match v3 design.
